name: Microsoft OneDrive
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Files.Read.All, and Files.ReadWrite.All for the writes; the token address holds your directory ID.

endpoints.name: list_user_drives
endpoints.description: Lists a user’s drives, by user ID or sign-in name; their OneDrive is the one whose driveType is business.

endpoints.name: list_root_items
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of the files and folders at the top of a drive.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_folder_items
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of the files and folders in a folder.

endpoints.name: get_item
endpoints.description: Returns a file’s or folder’s metadata; expand=children adds a folder’s items in the same call.

endpoints.name: list_item_permissions
endpoints.description: Lists the effective sharing permissions on a file or folder; those inherited from a folder above it carry inheritedFrom.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_file_versions
endpoints.description: Lists a file’s versions; which ones are kept, and for how long, depends on admin settings.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: search_files
endpoints.description: Searches OneDrive and SharePoint files and folders by keywords; region, the organization’s data location code (NAM, EUR, …), is required when the app signs in with application permissions, as it does here, and private files are included only when "sharePointOneDriveOptions": {"includeContent": "privateContent,sharedContent"} is added. Body: {"requests": [{"entityTypes": ["driveItem"], "query": {"queryString"}, "region", "from": 0, "size": 25}]}.

endpoints.name: create_folder
endpoints.description: Creates a folder inside a folder; root as the item ID is the top of the drive. Body: {"name", "folder": {}, "@microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior": "rename"}.

endpoints.name: create_sharing_link
endpoints.description: Creates a view or edit link to a file or folder, or returns the link of that type this app already made; scope organization opens it to people signed in to the organization, anonymous to anyone with the link if an admin allows it. Body: {"type": "view", "scope": "organization"}.
